Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/h2o && python3 -c "
data = open('fuzz/http2-corpus/001015fe2b4d4b50f1de1c8b295d1e5cecde8993','rb').read()
# split by marker
marker = b'\n--MARK--\n'
parts = data.split(marker)
print('num parts:', len(parts))
for i,p in enumerate(parts):
    print(f'--- part {i} len={len(p)} ---')
    # parse frames
    off = 0
    while off + 9 <= len(p):
        length = int.from_bytes(p[off:off+3],'big')
        ftype = p[off+3]
        flags = p[off+4]
        sid = int.from_bytes(p[off+5:off+9],'big')
        print(f'  frame: len={length} type={ftype} flags={flags:#x} sid={sid}')
        off += 9 + length
    if off < len(p):
        print(f'  leftover {len(p)-off} bytes')
"
